name: Cozy Admin Theme
author: Rachid Lajmi

sections.description:
Cozy Admin Theme transforms your WordPress admin panel into a beautiful, calming workspace.

Features

  • 5 Beautiful Color Schemes – Zen Garden, Sage & Cream, Terracotta Dreams, Soft Blush, Forest Retreat
  • Custom Colors – Create your own palette with color pickers
  • Complete Admin Styling – Menu, buttons, forms, tables, notices, and more
  • Login Page Customization – Beautiful gradient background, custom logo support
  • Typography Options – Choose from Inter, Nunito, or system fonts
  • Layout Options – Compact, default, or wide sidebar
  • Dashboard Widget – Cozy welcome widget with animations
  • Translation Ready – Fully internationalized

Why Cozy Admin Theme?

Tired of the default WordPress admin look? Cozy Admin Theme brings warmth and personality to your daily WordPress experience with:

  • Soft, eye-friendly color palettes
  • Smooth hover animations
  • Rounded corners for a modern feel
  • Custom scrollbars
  • Consistent styling across all admin pages
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cozy-admin-theme folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Cozy Theme in the admin menu to customize
sections.faq:
How do I change the colors?

Go to Cozy Theme in your admin menu. You can choose from 5 preset color schemes or create your own custom palette.

Can I use my own logo on the login page?

Yes! In the Cozy Theme settings, enable “Style Login Page” and upload your custom logo.

Will this affect my site’s frontend?

No, Cozy Admin Theme only styles the WordPress admin area and login page. Your site’s frontend remains unchanged.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

Yes, Cozy Admin Theme is designed to work alongside other plugins. If you notice any conflicts, please report them.

Can I add my own CSS?

Yes! There’s a Custom CSS field in the settings where you can add your own styles.
